responsibility: Adds VAX-specific machine-mode definitions and mode properties to GCC’s generated mode tables. It resets SFmode and DFmode to use the VAX floating-point formats rather than generic IEEE ones, and introduces the extra condition-code modes CCN, CCNZ, and CCZ that model which subsets of PSL flags are reliably set by different VAX instruction classes, enabling accurate compare generation and elimination in the RTL backend.
